prompt: a broadcast graphics package for a TV network in 1993
statement: This sketch creates a nostalgic homage to early 1990s broadcast television aesthetics, combining blocky neon typography with abstract geometric motion. The canvas displays a pulsing electric blue wireframe title card that continuously rotates, overlaid with randomly moving shapes that shift between ellipses and rectangles while cycling through saturated neon hues. When clicked, the entire scene instantly dissolves into a new title card with different text and color, simulating the rapid transition effects of vintage TV systems. The piece captures the digital signal noise and data flow visual language of that era through continuous motion and abrupt transitions, evoking both the technical limitations and distinctive visual identity of early digital television.
